Verdict: **PASS within the pure policy scope**, zero actionable findings. This review grants no actual concurrent Gradle, native UI, full app, test execution, CI, parity capture, lead merge or push gate.

Current source: `63c88dcf0eb7364521c5ea79b8cd67e63e4990b0` in `/workspace/android-studio-parallel-sync-policy`, including the approved ordinary merge of Root correction `9b9cbbc78e2ee035fe3f48f447f0072bd3aa17e2`. Read the implementation plan, current round2 freeze and approved rebound guard; entire parallel_sync.rs and ten declared tests; full pinned AgpVersion and original ModelVersionsTest; relevant BasicModules feature definition/ordering. Current cloud observations are connected/running. No Cargo, rustc, Gradle, app, runtime probe, source/cache edit, branch mutation or subagent was run. Only this external report was written.

## Eligibility behavior

`supports_parallel_sync` at src/parallel_sync.rs:42 requires an available captured version capability. It validates explicit AGP before using the model override. Its result exactly matches pinned BasicModules.kt:75 and136: numeric signed model producer>=8.0 OR AGP in [7.2.0,7.3.0-alpha01) OR AGP>=7.3.0-alpha04. Descriptions do not influence eligibility. Unsupported/malformed explicit AGP cannot become a successful model-override result.

The private comparator uses numeric components followed by Alpha<Beta<Rc<Dev<Stable, matching pinned AgpVersion.kt:36 and109. Numeric strings follow the exact nonnegative signed-Int bounds, no-leading-zero grammar, and historical preview spelling constraints at AgpVersion.kt:175–245. Contemporary previews require two digits; historical3.0/3.1-beta forms disallow zero padding;3.1.0 alpha/rc require two digits. -dev is correctly ordered after rc and before stable. The64-byte input cap permits every valid signed-Int spelling (maximum40 bytes) and bounds invalid diagnostic output.

The open/closed AGP edges are retained:7.2.0 previews are excluded;7.2.0 stable and later7.2 micro previews qualify;7.3.0-alpha01/02/03 are excluded by the AGP ranges;alpha04 onward qualifies. The valid alpha00 spelling falls below the first interval's exclusive alpha01 bound and therefore qualifies, consistent with the literal pinned ranges. Model8.0 can override those excluded AGP edges only after the AGP spelling validates.

## Errors and future consumers

Unavailable captured Versions retains Capability with its exact capability/detail. NotApplicable retains UnsupportedShape. Malformed numeric/preview/input strings are Malformed; unproved qualifiers are UnsupportedShape. These outcomes remain errors instead of being silently mapped to false or guessed support. The API performs no mutation, lookup, scheduling or project sync.

Minimum-consumer compatibility is deliberately separate: the original helper constructs minimumModelConsumer=null, and this feature does not consult it. The Rust test represents that original absence as an unavailable, unused field. A true return indicates the pinned feature eligibility; it does not establish consumer compatibility, permission/settings to use parallel scheduling, successful concurrent sync, or thread/process safety. Future controllers must retain their separate compatibility and workflow gates. No such controller or UI consumer exists in this change, so there is no current workflow mismatch from this separation.

## Original test fidelity

The complete original checkSupportsParallelSync method at ModelVersionsTest.kt:60 maps to tests/parallel_sync.rs:52. All nine literals, original order and outcomes are preserved:

| AGP | Expected support |
| --- | --- |
|7.2.0-rc01|false|
|7.2.0|true|
|7.2.1|true|
|7.2.2|true|
|7.3.0-alpha01|false|
|7.3.0-alpha02|false|
|7.3.0-alpha03|false|
|7.3.0-alpha04|true|
|7.3.0|true|

The helper still uses i32::MIN major and minor plus Some(empty description). Both positive and negative assertions retain the rendered named message “AGP {agp} supports parallel sync.” The original nullable minimum consumer remains unused rather than supplying a compatibility value. Nine additional tests cover exact/micro/preview ranges, all100 valid7.3 alphas, signed model override and preserved descriptions, unavailable capability, invalid-version precedence, unknown qualifiers, historical spelling, Int extremes and bounded long invalid input. These are static mappings only; all ten tests remain unexecuted in this review.

Original ModelVersionsTest/BasicModules references remain unchanged and attributed. Complete AgpVersion source, Apache license and NOTICE retain their pinned identities. No new non-Rust runtime or comparator was added.
